britannica-1911-kyshtym: Kyshtym is a town of Russia, in the government of Perm, 56 miles by rail N.N.W. of Chelyabinsk. It stands on a river of the same name, which links two lakes, and in 1897 it held 12,331 people. Its official name is Verkhne-Kyshtymskiy-Zavod, or Upper Kyshtym Works. That name sets it apart from the Lower Kyshtym Works, which lie two miles farther down the same river.
